info.name: IISIK_LR5
info.description: ЛР5: безопасность GraphQL API. Перед запуском: docker compose up -d redis, python scripts/seed_all.py, python scripts/run_all.py --mode http.

graphql.query: mutation { login(email: "analyst@example.com", password: "analyst") { token user { email roles } } }
mutation { login(email: "manager@example.com", password: "manager") { token user { email roles } } }
mutation { login(email: "admin@example.com", password: "admin") { token user { email roles } } }
mutation { createProduct(input: { name: "Без токена", category: "Прочее", price: 10 }) { id } }
mutation { createProduct(input: { name: "Запрещённый товар", category: "Прочее", price: 10 }) { id } }
mutation { createProduct(input: { name: "Postman LR5 товар {{$timestamp}}", category: "Прочее", price: 777, description: "Создан коллекцией ЛР5" }) { id name currentPrice } }
mutation { updateProduct(id: "{{created_product_id}}", input: { price: 888 }) { id currentPrice } }
mutation { decideRecommendation(id: "{{rec_id}}", decision: REJECTED) { id status } }
mutation { generateDemandForecast(productId: "20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", periodDays: 7) { id predictedDemand confidence } }

item.name: register нового пользователя → токен, роль ANALYST

graphql.query: mutation { register(email: "postman-{{$timestamp}}@example.com", password: "postman-pass", fullName: "Postman Пользователь") { token user { email roles } } }

item.name: register повторно тем же email → INVALID_OPERATION

graphql.query: mutation { register(email: "not-an-email", password: "postman-pass", fullName: "Без почты") { token } }

item.name: тот же JWT после logout → UNAUTHENTICATED
products под admin содержит созданный товар

graphql.query: query { products(search: "Postman LR5") { id name currentPrice } }
